notes: The exact subsection mappings below come from the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The scenario uses the valid standard SUPPORT_SERVICES group and valid handles from a joined peer so it isolates the declared connection and execution-membership exception boundaries before join and after resignation while connected. It does not claim handle encoding, normalized-coordinate semantics, cross-provider identity, or callback behavior.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember among the exceptions for normalizeServiceGroup. The test passes the valid standard SUPPORT_SERVICES group and checks NotConnected before connect plus FederateNotExecutionMember before join and after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember among the exceptions for normalizeFederateHandle. The test passes a valid joined-peer handle and checks NotConnected before connect plus FederateNotExecutionMember both after connect but before join and after resigning while connected.

The standard API declares NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember among the exceptions for normalizeObjectClassHandle. The test passes a valid FOM class handle from a joined peer and checks NotConnected before connect plus FederateNotExecutionMember before join and after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember among the exceptions for normalizeInteractionClassHandle. The test passes a valid FOM interaction handle from a joined peer and checks NotConnected before connect plus FederateNotExecutionMember before join and after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember among the exceptions for normalizeObjectInstanceHandle. The test passes a live object handle from a joined peer and checks NotConnected before connect plus FederateNotExecutionMember before join and after resignation while connected.
